component.name: Airlock
component.summary: Workspace-isolated Alt+Tab switcher for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: Airlock takes over Alt+Tab on the COSMIC desktop and lists only the windows of the current workspace, in most-recently-used order — nothing you parked on another workspace leaks into your focus. Sticky windows appear everywhere, minimized windows nowhere.

The overlay shows each window's application icon and title on a compact card; releasing Alt focuses the selection. Alt+grave cycles the current application's windows and Alt+Esc toggles to the previous one. A small daemon keeps the compositor state and switches in single-digit milliseconds; `airlock install` claims the keybind at user level and `airlock install --uninstall` restores the previous state byte-exactly.

ul.li: New: Alt+Esc opens the card over every workspace — hold Alt, tap Esc: the overlay lists all workspaces' windows, grouped by workspace with yours first, and Alt+Shift+Esc steps backwards through it. The key moves with the new `all_windows_key` setting (a keysym name, default Escape), and the CLI gains the same two moves: `airlock show-all-windows` and `airlock show-all-windows-previous`.

Changed: quick-toggle leaves the default bindings — its old Alt+Esc spot is now the all-windows card's, and the one-window jump is bound nowhere. Re-running `airlock install` migrates: the stale Alt+Esc entries come out, the new family goes in, and the report says so. Bind quick-toggle yourself in Settings → Input → Keyboard → Shortcuts → Custom if you use it.

Changed: the `…` tile counts what it hides — a truncated list's dots paint at full text strength instead of the faint hint ink, and the hidden windows' count appears beneath them as the same count dots parent tiles use, saturating at three.

Fixed: icons shipped as 8-bit palette PNGs render instead of degrading to a bare glyph — some Flatpak exports (Obsidian's among them) carry their icon masters as indexed PNGs. The rasterizer assembled only RGB and RGBA pixels, so a palette payload was rejected. Indexed sources are now expanded to truecolor by the decoder — palette indices and their tRNS alpha both resolve — before any bytes reach the assembly.

Fixed: with the workspace label showing (`show_workspace = true`), the vertical card's × badge revealed in the right place but its click territory sat 16 px above it, so a click on the visible × fell through and activated the window instead of closing it. The territory now sits exactly under the badge it belongs to.

New: the pointing-hand cursor over the card — the cursor turns into the hand the moment it enters the card and stays until it leaves: everything on the card is a click target. Needs the compositor's cursor-shape protocol (COSMIC has it); without it the cursor simply stays whatever it was.

Changed: a bigger × on every thumbnail — the close badge a hovered window tile reveals on its icon's top-right corner grows from 12 to 16 logical px (the × ink keeps its size, gaining air), and its click territory grows with it (16 → 20 px), so the smallest target on the card is easier to see and to hit. Both cards share the one badge, so the vertical rows' × grows with it.

Changed: on the grouped horizontal card, Alt+Tab from inside an app's open window run now steps the run's windows one at a time instead of jumping to the next app tile and closing the run; the run closes only when the walk steps off its edge.

Changed: pressing ` on an already-expanded app entry collapses the group in place instead of opening it again; a collapsed entry still opens on the most recently used window, **Shift+`** on the last. Inside a group the key cycles windows as before.

New: the `font_size` setting — set the card's text size in logical pixels (8–24, default 12); titles, the query strip, hint digits, and the band's caption and badges all follow, and the rows, lines, and bitmap floor holding them scale too. A larger size elides long titles sooner rather than widening the title band, and the `rows` budget clamps as fewer rows fit the panel. Read when a gesture starts; a value outside 8–24 is named in a diagnostic and the last-good settings apply.

New: the `width` and `min-width` settings — hold either card at a width floor (`"auto"`, `"100%"`, a percentage, or pixels); the card grows to the larger of the keys and its content, and the edit applies at the next gesture.
New: the `layout` setting — `"horizontal"` lays the list out as a wide band of tiles in a short card; `columns` sizes the band (3–12, or `"auto"`).

New: the `font` setting and real typography — titles paint the desktop's interface font by default, any installed family overrides it, and Unicode titles render their real glyphs instead of folding to ASCII.
New: app grouping (a two-level tree on `grouping = true`), type-to-filter while the card is up, close-window via Alt+minus or the hover ×, and a commented starter config on install.

New: the card follows the desktop's corner style and interface density — radius and row rhythm, no keys. Changed: grouped rows show a bare digit and pip counts. Fixed: config edits apply at the next gesture, and Alt+Shift+` steps the app's windows backwards.
New: the `rows` setting — how many windows the card keeps in view on a long list (3–10 in the config, default 8); continuation rows ride on top of that budget instead of spending it.

New: Ctrl+1..9 — with the overlay open, press Ctrl plus a number (keypad included) to switch to that row's window at once, like a click; the first nine rows show their key. (Shipped in 0.1.1 but its notes missed it.)
Changed: larger titles — 12 px (was 8), legible at a glance on 100 % scale; the card widens to at most 748 px.

Fixed: installing no longer resets every keyboard shortcut to defaults. 0.1.0 wrote three bindings in a form COSMIC rejects, which made the compositor fall back to factory defaults for the live session; nothing was deleted from disk — `airlock install --uninstall` restores, or upgrade and re-run `airlock install` to repair in place.
Fixed: Alt+Esc now actually fires — 0.1.0 bound a non-existent keysym name.
Workspace-isolated Alt+Tab overlay with application icons, MRU ordering, arrow keys, Enter commit, Escape dismiss.
Same-application cycling (Alt+grave) and no-overlay quick toggle (Alt+Esc).
Pointer input on the overlay — hover moves the selection, click activates, the wheel steps — and direct Ctrl+1..9 row selection, with each row's key shown beside it.
Long lists show a fixed eight-row window with continuation marks; a theme setting (dark/light/auto, default auto) follows the desktop's dark/light preference.
Per-workspace isolation config; installer-managed keybind takeover with byte-exact uninstall.
